00 / The Object

The Hybrid Jacket
混合夹克

Every brand needs its Puzzle bag. This is ours. But it is also a SOLUTION.
每个品牌都需要它的 Puzzle 包。这就是我们的。但它也是一个 SOLUTION。

When I joined Loewe, I did not start with a collection. I started with an object. The Puzzle bag. One item that contained the entire argument. Ye started Yeezy Season 1 by calling it the world's first SOLUTION-based clothing line. Not fashion. SOLUTION. TRIO is both. An object that argues, and a solution that silences the argument.

当我加入 Loewe 时，我不是从一个系列开始的。我是从一个物品开始的。Puzzle 包。一件包含了全部论点的物品。Ye 开启 Yeezy Season 1 时，称它为世界上第一条 SOLUTION-based 服装线。不是时尚。是 SOLUTION。TRIO 两者皆是。一个会争论的物品，和一个让争论沉默的 solution。

The Hybrid Jacket is half charcoal wool blazer, half sand-colored technical windbreaker. The two halves meet at a diagonal seam that runs from shoulder to hem, hand-stitched with visible thread. It is not "reversible" in the cheap sense. It is two garments that have decided to coexist. Ye would say: this is what happens when architecture meets the body. The seam is not a defect. The seam is the GENIUS.

混合夹克一半是炭灰色羊毛 blazer，一半是沙色技术面料风衣。两半在一个从肩膀到下摆的对角接缝处相遇，手工缝制，线迹可见。它不是廉价意义上的"双面穿"。它是两件决定共存的 garment。Ye 会说：这就是当 architecture 遇见身体时发生的事。接缝不是缺陷。接缝是 GENIUS。

This jacket is not a solution to a problem. It is a question that BECOMES the solution: Why did we ever believe that a man must choose between being dressed and being free?

这件夹克不是一个问题的 solution。它是一个变成 solution 的 question：我们为什么曾经相信，一个男人必须在"穿着得体"和"自由"之间做选择？

I put this object at the beginning of the Manifesto because everything else flows from it. Ye put the 350 at the center of Yeezy because it contained the entire thesis: simplicity as the ultimate complexity. The Hybrid Jacket is our 350. It is our Puzzle. It is the vessel that holds the contradiction.

我把这个物品放在 Manifesto 的开头，因为其他一切都从它流淌而出。Ye 把 350 放在 Yeezy 的中心，因为它包含了全部论点：简单作为终极的复杂。混合夹克就是我们的 350。它是我们的 Puzzle。它是承载矛盾的 vessel。

01 / Belief

Clothes Have No Business Being This Rational
衣服不该如此理性

Why should a blazer panic at the sight of a tennis court? Why should a polo shirt apologize for entering a meeting room?
为什么 blazer 看到网球场会 panic？为什么 polo 衫进入会议室需要道歉？

I have always believed that the most interesting things happen at the edges, where categories blur and rules dissolve. Ye believes that the system is designed to exclude, and the only response is to BUILD YOUR OWN. At Loewe, I put a rose on a shoe heel. At Yeezy, Ye made a hoodie that looked like a ruin. Not because it was practical. Because it made people feel something. Because it was TRUE.

我一直相信，最有趣的事情发生在边缘，在那里 categories 模糊，rules 溶解。Ye 相信这个体系的设计就是排除，而唯一的回应是 BUILD YOUR OWN。在 Loewe，我把玫瑰放在鞋跟上。在 Yeezy，Ye 做了一件看起来像废墟的 hoodie。不是因为它 practical。是因为它让人们 feel something。因为它是 TRUE。

TRIO starts with a simple provocation: the modern man does not live in compartments. His morning begins with coffee and emails, his afternoon with a backhand down the line, his evening with a negroni and conversation. Three scenes. One day. One body. Ye would ask: why does he need three different uniforms to be ONE person?

TRIO 从一个简单的 provocation 开始：现代男人不生活在隔间里。他的早晨从咖啡和邮件开始，下午从一个反手直线球开始，晚上从一杯 negroni 和 conversation 开始。三个场景。一天。一个身体。Ye 会问：为什么他需要三套不同的 uniform 才能成为 ONE person？

This is not "versatile clothing." That phrase belongs to marketing decks. This is something stranger and more honest: the recognition that a man's clothes should understand his life better than he does. They should anticipate the pivot from desk to court to bar, not resist it. Ye calls this SOLUTION-based. I call it obvious. But obvious is the hardest thing to design. Because obvious means you have removed everything that is not necessary.

这不是"多功能服装"。那个 phrase 属于 marketing decks。这是更奇怪、更 honest 的东西：认识到一个男人的衣服应该比他更懂他的生活。它们应该 anticipate 从办公桌到球场到酒吧的 pivot，而不是抵抗它。Ye 称之为 SOLUTION-based。我称之为 obvious。但 obvious 是最难 design 的东西。因为 obvious 意味着你已经移除了所有不必要的东西。

And here is where I must be honest about my own history, and Ye's. When I started JW Anderson, I put men in ruffled shorts and women in oversized tailoring. People called it "gender-fluid." I called it obvious. Ye was putting women in oversized military hoodies and men in body stockings. The body does not care about the labels we give it. TRIO carries that same disregard for categories — not as a political statement, but as a design principle. A garment that works for a man moving through three scenes is, by definition, a garment that refuses to be one thing. It is a SOLUTION to a life that refuses to be one thing.

而在这里我必须诚实地面对我自己和 Ye 的历史。当我创立 JW Anderson 时，我让男性穿荷叶边短裤，让女性穿 oversized tailoring。人们称之为"性别流动"。我称之为obvious。Ye 让女性穿 oversized 军事 hoodie，让男性穿 body stockings。身体不在乎我们给它的 labels。TRIO 携带同样的对 categories 的 disregard——不是作为政治声明，而是作为设计原则。一件为一个在三个场景中移动的男人工作的 garment，by definition，就是一件拒绝成为一件东西的 garment。它是对一条拒绝成为一件东西的生活的 SOLUTION。

We are not designing for a man who has three different wardrobes. We are designing for a man who has one life, lived at speed, and refuses to let his clothes slow him down. Ye would say: we are designing for the CREATOR who refuses to let the system define him.

我们不是为一个有三套不同 wardrobe 的男人设计。我们是为一个只有一条生命、高速生活、拒绝让他的衣服拖慢他的男人设计。Ye 会说：我们是为那个拒绝让体系定义他的 CREATOR 设计。

02 / Craft

The Hand That Makes the Cloth
织造布料的那双手

Craft is not exclusivity. Craft is returning to the original thing. Every stitch carries a story of someone's hands. In a world of ruins, the hand is the last truth.
工艺不是排他性。工艺是回归原始之物。每一针都承载着某人双手的故事。在废墟的世界里，手是最后的 truth。

When I visit the Loewe atelier in Madrid, I am not looking for perfection. I am looking for the slight irregularity that tells you a human being was there. Ye, when he worked with Claudio Silvestrin on his apartment, learned the same lesson: perfection is not the absence of flaw. Perfection is the PRESENCE of intention. The ceramic buttons on our 2024 collection were inspired by Lucie Rie — each one slightly different, each one alive. That is what I want TRIO to feel like: not manufactured, but made. Not designed, but willed into existence.

当我参观马德里的 Loewe 工坊时，我不是在寻找 perfection。我在寻找那种轻微的 irregularity，它告诉你一个人曾经在那里。Ye，当他和 Claudio Silvestrin 合作设计他的公寓时，学到了同样的教训：perfection 不是 flawless。Perfection 是 intention 的 PRESENCE。我们 2024 系列的陶瓷纽扣灵感来自 Lucie Rie——每一个都略有不同，每一个都 alive。这就是我希望 TRIO 给人的感觉：不是 manufactured，而是 made。不是 designed，而是被 will 进存在。

Charles Rennie Mackintosh, the Glasgow architect, taught me something crucial: radical ideas in craft eventually change everything else. Ye learned the same from Silvestrin's concrete walls — the color of the material itself becomes the color palette. No paint. No veneer. Just the truth of the material. He painted rooms white when everyone else used oak and velvet. A century later, his rooms still feel modern. TRIO's materials are chosen with the same conviction:

格拉斯哥建筑师 Charles Rennie Mackintosh 教给了我一些 crucial 的东西：工艺中的 radical ideas 最终会改变其他一切。Ye 从 Silvestrin 的混凝土墙中学到了同样的东西——材料本身的颜色就是色板。没有油漆。没有 veneer。只有材料的 truth。当所有人都用橡木和天鹅绒时，他把房间漆成白色。一个世纪后，他的房间仍然感觉 modern。TRIO 的材料选择带着同样的 conviction：

Material / 材质 Origin / 来源 Why It Matters / 为何重要
Merino-Silk Knit
美利奴丝混纺针织		 Italian mill, family-run since 1923
意大利工坊，1923 年家族经营至今		 The drape of silk, the resilience of wool. A blazer that breathes like a sweater. The SOLUTION to the meeting that turns into a match.
丝绸的垂坠，羊毛的韧性。一件像 sweater 一样呼吸的 blazer。对"变成比赛的会议"的 SOLUTION。
Four-Way Stretch Cotton
四面弹棉		 Japanese technical weavers
日本技术织工		 Tailored silhouette with the hidden generosity of sportswear. You forget you're wearing it. The architecture of the body, unrestricted.
精裁 silhouette，带着运动服隐藏的 generosity。你忘记自己穿着它。身体的 architecture，不受限制。
Hand-Dyed Linen
手染亚麻		 Portuguese atelier
葡萄牙工坊		 Each batch carries subtle variation — the color of sand after rain, of stone at dusk. No two garments the same. No algorithm can replicate this.
每批都有微妙的变化——雨后沙子的颜色，黄昏时石头的颜色。没有两件 garment 相同。没有算法可以复制这个。

工作室陶艺，单独烧制		 Cool against the skin. Imperfect by design. No two alike. The hand leaves its signature. This is the anti-mass-production.
贴在皮肤上清凉。设计上不完美。没有两个相同。手留下它的 signature。这是 anti-mass-production。

The Color of History / 历史的颜色

I spent hours in the British Museum's room of Chinese monochrome glazes. Ye spent years in his Silvestrin apartment, where the only colors were concrete, stone, and the light that changed them. Those colors — celadon, oxblood, ivory, salt, rock, oil — are more modern than anything on a Pantone chart. They are the colors of ruins. Of survival. Of what remains when everything unnecessary has been stripped away. TRIO's palette is an homage:

我在大英博物馆的中国单色釉展厅里度过了数小时。Ye 在他的 Silvestrin 公寓里度过了数年，那里唯一的颜色是混凝土、石头，和改变它们的光线。那些颜色——青瓷、牛血红、象牙白、盐、岩石、油——比 Pantone 色卡上的任何东西都更 modern。它们是废墟的颜色。是生存的颜色。是当一切不必要的东西被剥离后，remaining 的颜色。TRIO 的色板是一种致敬：

Ivory 象牙白
Sand 沙色
Charcoal 炭灰
Indigo 靛蓝
Terracotta 赤陶
Moss 苔藓绿
Amber 琥珀

These are not fashion colors. They are archaeological colors — excavated from ceramics, from stone, from the slow weathering of things that last. They do not shout. They settle. Ye would call them the colors of dystopian minimalism: what remains after the collapse. I call them the colors of craft: what persists because it is true.

这些不是时尚颜色。它们是考古颜色——从陶瓷中挖掘出来，从石头中挖掘出来，从持久之物的缓慢风化中挖掘出来。它们不 shout。它们 settle。Ye 会称它们为末日极简的颜色：collapse 之后 remaining 的东西。我称它们为工艺的颜色：因为它 true 而 persist 的东西。

The Craft Promise / 工艺承诺

Loewe has the Craft Prize. TRIO will have something smaller but no less serious: each season, one piece made in collaboration with a living craftsperson from a different country. Season One: a Portuguese ceramicist for the buttons. Season Two: perhaps a Japanese indigo dyer. Season Three: a Scottish knitter. The craftsperson's name appears on the label, alongside the garment's. This is not charity. This is not marketing. This is conversation. This is Ye's Creator Sovereignty applied to the hands that make the thing: the maker owns their part of the story.

Loewe 有工艺奖。TRIO 会有更小但同样严肃的东西：每一季，一件与来自不同国家的在世工艺师合作制作的单品。第一季：一位葡萄牙陶艺师制作纽扣。第二季：也许是一位日本靛蓝染工。第三季：一位苏格兰编织工。工艺师的名字出现在标签上，与 garment 的名字并列。这不是慈善。这不是营销。这是对话。这是 Ye 的 Creator Sovereignty 应用于制作物品的手：maker 拥有他们那部分故事。

03 / Identity

The Man Who Refuses to Be One Thing
拒绝被定义的男人

He does not have a work self and a weekend self. He has one self, expressed through many rooms. He is the creator of his own uniform.
他没有工作自我和周末自我。他只有一个自我，通过许多房间表达。他是自己 uniform 的创造者。

I do not believe in target demographics. Ye does not believe in gatekeepers. The man who wears TRIO is obsessed with the in-between: the hour when work bleeds into play, the outfit that does not announce where you are going because it does not care. He is not a "consumer." He is a collector of moments. He is not being sold to. He is being given a SOLUTION to a problem the industry created.

我不相信目标人群。Ye 不相信 gatekeepers。穿 TRIO 的男人痴迷于 in-between：工作渗入 play 的那个小时，不宣告你要去哪里的 outfit，因为它不在乎。他不是"消费者"。他是时刻的收藏家。他不是被销售的对象。他被给予了一个对行业制造的问题的 SOLUTION。

He might be 28 or 42. He might code, or trade, or curate, or build. What unites him is not age or income. It is a restlessness with the expected. He has stood in front of his wardrobe at 7 AM and thought: Why do I need three different versions of myself today? Ye stood in front of the fashion industry and asked the same question. The answer was: you don't. The answer was: BUILD YOUR OWN.

他可能 28 岁或 42 岁。他可能 coding，或 trading，或 curating，或 building。连接他的不是年龄或收入。而是对 expected 的 restless。他曾在早上 7 点站在 wardrobe 前想：为什么我今天需要三个不同的自己？ Ye 站在时尚行业面前问了同样的问题。答案是：你不需要。答案是：BUILD YOUR OWN。

The most radical thing a man can do with his clothes is to stop apologizing for them. Stop explaining why the blazer is knit, why the trousers stretch, why the polo is oversized. Just wear it. Let the clothes do the talking. The system wants you to explain. The SOLUTION needs no explanation.

一个男人对他的衣服能做的最 radical 的事情，就是停止为它们道歉。停止解释为什么 blazer 是针织的，为什么 trousers 有弹力，为什么 polo 是 oversized。穿上就好。让衣服自己说话。体系想要你解释。SOLUTION 不需要解释。

— Jonathan Anderson & Ye for TRIO

I must say something here that I have learned the hard way, and Ye learned harder. Even if you are hated, it is better than being ignored. My early collections were ridiculed. Men in ruffles? Absurd. Ye's early Paris shows were laughed out of the room. But the ridicule meant they were seen. The worst fate for a designer is not criticism — it is silence. TRIO will make some people uncomfortable. The Hybrid Jacket will look wrong to someone who believes a blazer must be wool from collar to hem. Good. Wrong is the first step toward new. Ye would say: NUMBER ONE. Being wrong and being number one are the same thing.

我在这里必须说一些我通过艰难方式学到的东西，而 Ye 学得更艰难。哪怕被讨厌，也好过无人问津。我的早期系列被嘲笑。男人穿荷叶边？荒谬。Ye 的早期巴黎秀被嘲笑出场。但嘲笑意味着它们被看见了。对设计师来说最坏的命运不是批评——是沉默。TRIO 会让一些人感到不舒服。混合夹克在那些相信 blazer 必须从领子到下摆都是羊毛的人看来会是 wrong 的。好。Wrong 是通往 new 的第一步。Ye 会说：NUMBER ONE。Being wrong 和 being number one 是同一件事。

Accessibility, Not Democracy / 可触及，非民主

I have worked with Uniqlo for eight years. Ye tried to put Yeezy in Gap for $20. We both know the tension between making something beautiful and making it available. TRIO sits in the space between the disposable and the unattainable:

我与 Uniqlo 合作了八年。Ye 试图把 Yeezy 放进 Gap 卖 20 美元。我们都知道做出美丽的东西和让它可及之间的 tension。TRIO 位于一次性与不可触及之间的空间：

800–2000
Core pieces / 核心单品 / CNY
2000–4000
Outerwear / 外套 / CNY
300–800
Accessories / 配饰 / CNY

Not cheap. Not precious. Worthy of the life you are living. Ye wanted $20 Yeezys. I understand that impulse. But TRIO is not about democracy. It is about ACCESS. The difference is: democracy lowers the standard. Access raises the person. You are not buying a brand. You are buying a SOLUTION to the problem of being alive in a world that wants to categorize you.

不便宜。不珍贵。配得上你正在过的生活。Ye 想要 20 美元的 Yeezy。我理解那个 impulse。但 TRIO 不是关于 democracy。它是关于 ACCESS。区别在于：democracy 降低标准。Access 提升人。你不是在买一个品牌。你是在买一个 SOLUTION，解决在一个想要分类你的世界里活着的问题。

04 / Collection

A Curated Wardrobe, Not a Product Line
策展式衣橱，非产品线

Each piece is an independent object. Worn together, they become a conversation. And every conversation needs one voice that does not belong.
每件都是独立的物品。一起穿，它们变成对话。而每个对话都需要一个不属于这里的声音。

I think of dressing as curation. Ye thinks of dressing as architecture. You do not wear an outfit. You assemble a dialogue between textures, proportions, histories — or you inhabit a space that the clothes have built around you. TRIO's core collection is designed as six independent voices that harmonize without agreeing:

我把 dressing 视为策展。Ye 把 dressing 视为建筑。你不是穿一套 outfit。你是在 texture、proportion、history 之间 assemble 一个对话——或者你 inhabit 一个衣服在你周围建造的空间。TRIO 的核心系列被设计为六个独立的声音，它们 harmonize 而不 agree：

Hybrid Jacket 混合夹克

The object that contains the entire argument. Half tailoring, half sport. The seam is the philosophy made visible. This is where TRIO begins. Ye would say: this is the SOLUTION made fabric.

包含全部论点的物品。一半是 tailoring，一半是运动。接缝就是哲学被可视化。这就是 TRIO 开始的地方。Ye 会说：这是被制成织物的 SOLUTION。

Knit Blazer 针织西装外套

The structure of tailoring, the touch of knitwear. Wear it with trousers for a meeting, with shorts for a Saturday. It does not judge either choice. Architecture that breathes.

Tailoring 的结构，knitwear 的触感。配 trousers 去开会，配 shorts 过周六。它不会评判任何一个选择。会呼吸的 architecture。

Stretch Trousers 弹力西裤

The silhouette of formality, the secret of stretch. Cuffed for the court, uncuffed for the office. The same pair, two different men. The body moves, the cloth follows. No resistance.

Formal 的 silhouette，stretch 的秘密。卷裤脚去球场，放下裤脚去办公室。同一条裤子，两个不同的男人。身体移动，布料跟随。没有 resistance。

Oversized Polo 廓形 Polo 衫

Tennis heritage, architectural scale. The collar says country club. The cut says art school. The most polite rebellion in menswear. Ye would wear this with military boots and call it uniform.

Tennis 的 heritage，建筑的 scale。领子说乡村俱乐部。剪裁说艺术学校。男装中最礼貌的 rebellion。Ye 会配军事靴穿这个，称之为 uniform。

Merino Tee 美利奴羊毛 T 恤

The simplest piece, the hardest to perfect. Thin enough to layer, substantial enough to stand alone. The foundation everything else rests on. The concrete slab of the wardrobe.

最简单的单品，最难 perfect。薄到可以 layering，厚实到可以 standalone。一切其他东西 resting on 的基础。Wardrobe 的混凝土板。

Sunset Jacket 日落夹克

Light as wind, sharp as dusk. The piece you reach for when the day turns into evening and you have no intention of going home to change. The transition garment. The SOLUTION to the in-between.

轻如 wind，sharp 如 dusk。当白天变成夜晚、你没有打算回家换衣服时，你会伸手去拿的那件。过渡 garment。对 in-between 的 SOLUTION。

The Irrational Edge / 非理性边缘

Every season, the collection includes one piece that does not belong. Not as a separate "Lab." Not as an experiment. As a necessary disruption within the family. Ye's collections always had that one piece — the body stocking, the transparent boot, the thing that made people uncomfortable. The irrational edge is what keeps the rational center honest. Without it, the collection becomes a formula. And formulas are the death of fashion. Formulas are the death of SOLUTIONS.

每一季，系列中都包含一件不属于这里的单品。不是作为独立的"实验室"。不是作为实验。作为家族中必要的 disruption。Ye 的系列总有那一件——body stocking、透明靴、那件让人们不舒服的东西。非理性边缘是让理性中心保持 honest 的东西。没有它，系列就变成了 formula。而 formulas 是时尚的死亡。Formulas 是 SOLUTIONS 的死亡。

Season 01 / 第一季

Tennis String Vest

网球线背心

Woven from actual racket string. Unwearable for most. Unforgettable for all. The piece that makes people ask: is this serious? Ye would say: it's not serious. It's TRUE.

用真正的球拍线编织。对大多数人来说 unwearable。对所有人来说 unforgettable。那件让人们问：这是认真的吗？Ye 会说：它不是 serious。它是 TRUE。

Season 02 / 第二季

The 3/4 Shirt

四分之三衬衫

Dress-length shirt, worn as outerwear. A garment that questions where clothing ends and architecture begins. Ye would wear this as a coat and call it shelter.

连衣裙长度的衬衫，作为 outerwear 穿。一件质疑 clothing 在哪里结束、architecture 在哪里开始的 garment。Ye 会把这个当 coat 穿，称之为 shelter。

Season 03 / 第三季

Ceramic Button Cardigan

陶瓷纽扣开衫

Each button thrown on a potter's wheel, glazed by hand, fired once. No two closures alike. The craftsperson's name on the label. The maker owns their mark.

每个纽扣在陶轮上抛出，手工上釉，一次烧制。没有两个 closure 相同。工艺师的名字在标签上。Maker 拥有他们的 mark。

05 / Debut

Day Shift: A Single Day, Undressed
日班：一天，无需更衣

The first collection is not a season. It is a day. From coffee to court to candlelight, without a single change of clothes. A SOLUTION to the day itself.
第一个系列不是一个季节。它是一天。从咖啡到球场到烛光，无需换一件衣服。对一天本身的 SOLUTION。

I do not believe in fashion shows as entertainment. Ye does not believe in fashion shows as industry events. I believe in them as experiences you cannot forget. Ye believes in them as cultural moments that break the system. TRIO's debut will not happen on a runway. It will happen in a space that already contains all three worlds — a converted tennis club, where the court becomes a conference room becomes a bar. The audience will move through the day as the clothes do: seamlessly, without announcement. Ye would fill it with 20,000 people and play an album. I would fill it with 200 and let them touch the clothes. TRIO does both.

我不相信时装秀作为 entertainment。Ye 不相信时装秀作为行业活动。我相信它们作为你无法忘记的体验。Ye 相信它们作为打破体系的文化时刻。TRIO 的首秀不会在 runway 上发生。它会在一个已经包含三个世界的空间里发生——一个改造的网球俱乐部，球场变成会议室，会议室变成酒吧。观众会像衣服一样穿过这一天：seamlessly，无需宣告。Ye 会塞满 20000 人放一张专辑。我会塞满 200 人让他们触摸衣服。TRIO 两者都做。

The model — and I use that word carefully — will not change clothes. He will simply turn. The Hybrid Jacket reversed. The trousers cuffed. The polo tucked, then untucked. Transformation without removal. This is the essence of TRIO: not that you own many things, but that the things you own contain multitudes. Ye would say: this is the SOLUTION to the wardrobe. One garment, infinite configurations. The architecture of the self, reconfigurable.

模特——我谨慎地使用这个词——不会换衣服。他只是转身。混合夹克翻面。裤子卷边。Polo 塞进去，然后放出来。无需脱下的 transformation。这就是 TRIO 的 essence：不是你拥有很多东西，而是你拥有的东西包含 multitude。Ye 会说：这是对 wardrobe 的 SOLUTION。一件 garment，无限配置。自我的 architecture，可重新配置。

Do not try to please everyone. Some will say it is not formal enough for the office, not athletic enough for the court, not loud enough for the bar. They are right. It is none of those things. It is something else entirely. And for the man who recognizes what that something is — there is nothing else he would rather wear. Ye would say: if they don't get it, they don't get it. The SOLUTION speaks for itself.

不要试图取悦所有人。有人会说它对办公室不够 formal，对球场不够 athletic，对酒吧不够 loud。他们是对的。它不是那些东西中的任何一个。它完全是 something else。而对于那个认出那个 something 是什么的男人——没有别的他更愿意穿。Ye 会说：如果他们不懂，他们就是不懂。SOLUTION 自己会说话。

— Jonathan Anderson & Ye for TRIO

TRIO is not clothing for multiple occasions. It is clothing for one occasion: the occasion of being alive, moving through spaces, refusing to be categorized. The office does not own you. The court does not own you. The bar does not own you. Your clothes should not own you either. Ye would add: and the industry that made those clothes definitely does not own you. You are the CREATOR. The clothes are the VESSEL. The life is the ART.

TRIO 不是为多种场合设计的衣服。它是为一种场合设计的衣服：活着的场合，穿过空间的场合，拒绝被分类的场合。办公室不拥有你。球场不拥有你。酒吧不拥有你。你的衣服也不应该拥有你。Ye 会补充：而制造那些衣服的行业绝对不拥有你。你是 CREATOR。衣服是 VESSEL。生活是 ART。

TRIO

Clothes that understand the day before you do. / 衣服比你更懂这一天。
